decisions.decision: Committee agreed to set a baseline requirement of familiarity and experience with historic preservation for the firms considered.
decisions.quote: the committee agreed that setting a baseline requirement of familiarity and experience with historic preservation would ensure that the firms considered had the relevant expertise.

decisions.decision: Selection process: non-price proposals are reviewed first, then price proposals are opened; the highest-ranking firm is awarded the contract based on qualifications and price.
decisions.quote: the selection process will involve reviewing the non-price proposals first, followed by opening the price proposals.

decisions.decision: Committee suggested adding RFP language on long-term operation and maintenance costs and energy efficiency analysis to the design requirements.
decisions.quote: the committee suggested adding language regarding long-term operation and maintenance costs, as well as energy efficiency analysis, as part of the design requirements.

decisions.decision: Michael Ray Jeffreys to review the matter with Julie and report back to the committee.
decisions.quote: michael ray jeffreys will review with julie and get back to the committee.

decisions.decision: Recommended that the committee meet with other boards during the process to keep everyone informed.
decisions.quote: it was recommended that we meet with other boards during the process to keep everyone informed.
